stage: G6 compressed native checkpoint restore without a temporary raw RAM file
behavior: Raw RAM takes precedence. When absent, decode .state.zst to bounded memory and verify original decoded size/SHA plus paired disk overlays and guest geometry before VM restoration. Release decoded input after restore.
validation: Unit regressions cover raw preference, exact compressed bytes, no temporary raw file, wrong size/SHA, truncated archives, bounded decompression, corrupted raw and missing Node zstd capability.
Real original native XP 93.71/3DMark06 pre-run GUI restored 1464808072 decoded bytes from a 650667581-byte archive, with paired overlays verified; NVIDIA started1/problem0 and 1024x768 display.
No guest, driver, clock or watchdog changes.
